name: University of Zurich
description: The University of Zurich is a public university in Zurich, founded in 1833. With about 28,000 students it is Switzerland's largest university.
whyIncluded: Its medical degree is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications, it is Switzerland's largest university, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own minimum estimate of rent, food, transport and personal costs for 12 months a year. Excludes insurance, taxes and tuition; it warns international students face extra costs.
livingCosts.notes: UZH Student Financial Aid Office 'General estimates (minimal costs per month)': housing (rent, heating, energy) CHF 910; food CHF 450; travel CHF 95; personal (clothing, hygiene, leisure, phone) CHF 270. Excludes the study line (CHF 250, which includes tuition), insurance/AHV (CHF 200) and tax reserve (CHF 25). UZH's own minimum total is CHF 2,200 a month and it warns international students face extra costs. Page undated; read September 2026.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Informatics
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students, including a CHF 500 per semester surcharge for foreign bachelor's students, plus compulsory semester contributions. A one-off CHF 150 application fee is extra.
programmes.notes: Tuition CHF 720 per semester + CHF 500 surcharge for foreign students at bachelor level = CHF 1,220 x 2. Mandatory semester contributions CHF 59 x 2 (scholarship fund, libraries, ASVZ sports, student concerns). One-off application fee CHF 150 for applicants with foreign qualifications (non-refundable). 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German. Fee page is undated; rates read September 2026. Fee history: tuition for 2024 (HS 2024 + FS 2025) and 2025 (HS 2025 + FS 2026) from the cantonal Verordnung über die Studiengebühren an der Universität Zürich (LS 415.321: CHF 720 per semester in both the version in force 1 Aug 2022 - 1 Jan 2025 and the version in force from 1 Jan 2025) plus the Verordnung über die zusätzliche Studiengebühr von ausländischen Studierenden (LS 415.322, in force since 1 May 2012: CHF 500 bachelor, CHF 100 master per semester), both on the Canton of Zurich's ZH-Lex (zh.ch) site. Application fee was CHF 100 until 31 Dec 2024 and CHF 150 for foreign qualifications from 1 Jan 2025 (amendment of 3 June 2024). Mandatory semester contributions are omitted from the history rows because the Zulassungsreglement annex only publishes the current (1 Jan 2026) amounts.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine (Humanmedizin, 180 ECTS)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students, including a foreign-student surcharge, plus semester contributions. A CHF 150 application fee is extra. Medicine admits foreign nationals only with a residence permit approved by the university.
programmes.notes: Tuition CHF 720 per semester + CHF 500 surcharge for foreign students at bachelor level = CHF 1,220 x 2. Mandatory semester contributions CHF 59 x 2. One-off application fee CHF 150 for foreign qualifications. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German, followed by the 3-year Master of Medicine. Admission to medicine is capped by the Canton of Zurich with an aptitude test (EMS) via swissuniversities, and UZH admits applicants of foreign nationality only if they hold a residence permit approved by UZH. Universität Zürich (Medizinische Fakultät) is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications; the registrable qualification is the federal diploma taken after the master's, not the bachelor's alone. Fee history: tuition for 2024 (HS 2024 + FS 2025) and 2025 (HS 2025 + FS 2026) from the cantonal Verordnung über die Studiengebühren an der Universität Zürich (LS 415.321: CHF 720 per semester in both the version in force 1 Aug 2022 - 1 Jan 2025 and the version in force from 1 Jan 2025) plus the Verordnung über die zusätzliche Studiengebühr von ausländischen Studierenden (LS 415.322, in force since 1 May 2012: CHF 500 bachelor, CHF 100 master per semester), both on the Canton of Zurich's ZH-Lex (zh.ch) site. Application fee was CHF 100 until 31 Dec 2024 and CHF 150 for foreign qualifications from 1 Jan 2025 (amendment of 3 June 2024). Mandatory semester contributions are omitted from the history rows because the Zulassungsreglement annex only publishes the current (1 Jan 2026) amounts.
